# Weather
Hazardous weather fronts roll across the WH14K battlefield at random. Each lasts three to ten minutes and hits everyone caught under the open sky. Roofs, armor and gas masks are your only chance to ride out the storm.
## How to protect yourself - [color=#a4885c]Hardsuit[/color] holds back ash, toxic ash, acid rain, sand hurricane and metal hail. - [color=#a4885c]Gas mask or hardsuit[/color] save you from the radiation front and spore drift. - [color=#ff0000]Nothing protects[/color] from the ion storm, black ice, gellar tremor, machine corrosion and black front — hide under a roof and wait it out.
## Fire and ash - [color=#a4885c]Ash[/color] — soft volcanic dust, lightly burns. A hardsuit is enough. - [color=#a4885c]Toxic ash[/color] — a caustic mix that burns and poisons at once, and slows you. A hardsuit is mandatory. - [color=#a4885c]Acid rain[/color] — eats flesh and corrodes structures. You won't last long under the open sky.
## Radiation and spores - [color=#a4885c]Radiation front[/color] — a glowing cloud that irradiates everyone beneath it and sometimes hits with a local pulse. [color=#a4885c]Wear a gas mask[/color] — it's the cheapest way not to die. - [color=#a4885c]Spore drift[/color] — a toxic haze that poisons the lungs. Again, gas mask or hardsuit.
## Storms without mercy - [color=#a4885c]Ion storm[/color] — knocks out electronics with an EMP over an area. Tech stalls, sights go blind. You can't hide — just wait it out. - [color=#a4885c]Black ice[/color] — a freezing front that grips the ground in ice and slows everyone. Careful on open ground. - [color=#a4885c]Sand hurricane[/color] — wind shoves fighters around and cuts visibility. A hardsuit softens the slow, but won't stop the wind. - [color=#a4885c]Metal hail[/color] — a piercing rain of shards that wounds people and corrodes structures. A hardsuit helps, but cover is better.
## Warp and machines - [color=#a4885c]Gellar tremor[/color] — a shudder of the warp that slows everyone and flickers the lights. [color=#ff0000]Ignores roofs[/color] — you can't hide. - [color=#a4885c]Machine corrosion[/color] — a rust front that devours [color=#a4885c]vehicles and turrets[/color]. Pull iron off open positions or the storm eats your defense. - [color=#a4885c]Black front[/color] — a round event, a dark storm that slows everyone. But captured influence points yield [color=#a4885c]twice the income[/color] — seize the moment.
## How to survive a storm - Always keep a gas mask in your backpack — it saves you from radiation and spores for cheap. - Build roofs over positions, ore extractors and turrets — your main shield against ash, rain, hail and ice. - Remember: the ion storm and gellar tremor [color=#ff0000]ignore roofs[/color] — you can only wait them out. - During machine corrosion pull vehicles under a roof or you'll lose your defenses.
